ταχέας: ταχύς — swift; masc. acc. pl., epic -έας (= Attic ταχεῖς), agreeing with ὀϊστούς: ’swift’

ἀνιάζων: ἀνιάζω — grieve, distress; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’in anguish’

ἀντιάσεις: ἀντιάω — meet, encounter, take part in (+ gen.); fut. 2 sg.: ’you will meet with’

ἀποδώσομεν: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, pay; fut. 1 pl.: ’we shall pay back’

__broaden__.αἵματος: αἷμα — blood; neut. gen. sg., with ἆσσον ’nearer to’ · also neut. gen. sg. of descent, after εἰμί: ’of (our) blood’ (ἐμός ἐσσι καὶ αἵματος ἡμετέροιο ’you are mine and of our blood’) · also neut. gen. sg. of the stuff filled with or smeared with: ’with blood’ (κνίσης τε καὶ αἵματος ἐμπλήσαντες; στῆθος … φύρσω αἵματος) · also neut. gen. sg. of material, with αὐλός: ’of blood’ (αὐλὸς … αἵματος ἀνδρομέοιο ’a jet of human blood’)
__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’) · also masc. gen. sg. after περί: ’about himself’ (περί τ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ περὶ πάντων) · also plain gen. sg. pronoun governed by ἄγχι ’near’: ’him’ (ἄγχι δ’ αὐτοῦ ’close beside him’) · also gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with a participle: ’with him himself still living’ (αὐτοῦ ζώοντος)
__broaden__.βάλεν: βάλλω — throw, cast; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, in tmesis with ἀμφί: ’threw about’ · also in tmesis with ἐπί (βάλεν δ’ ἐπὶ ... ἑκάστῳ = ἐπέβαλε): ’threw over, cast upon’ · also in tmesis with παρά (πάρ … βάλεν = παρέβαλε): ’threw beside, set before’ · also without tmesis, with κε, unreal past: ’would have hurled’ (κε … βάλεν … ποτὶ πέτρας ’would have dashed her against the rocks’) · also in tmesis with ἐν (ἐν … βάλεν = ἐνέβαλε): ’cast into, sent upon’ (φύζαν … βάλεν ’sent panic upon’) · also plain aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with no tmesis: ’let fall’ (δάκρυ χαμαὶ βάλεν ’let a tear fall to the ground’) · also plain aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, ’hit, struck’, the target or the weapon given: σκοπὸν … βάλεν ’hit a mark’, βάλεν ἰῷ ’struck with an arrow’
__broaden__.βέλος: βέλος — missile, thing thrown; neut. acc. sg. (here a hurled rock) · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’missile’ (βέλος Ἀντινόοιο ’the missile of Antinous’) · also neut. acc. sg., an arrow: ’shaft’ (θοὸν βέλος ’swift shaft’)
__broaden__.γένοιτο: γίγνομαι — become, happen, turn out; aor. opt. 3 sg. (ὅπως ἄριστα γένοιτο ’how it might turn out best’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish with μή: μὴ ... φίλον γένοιτο ’may it not prove pleasing’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after αἲ γάρ: αἲ γὰρ τοῦτο γένοιτο ’would that this might happen’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after εἰ γάρ: εἰ γὰρ … ἔρις γένοιτο ’if only a contest might arise’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή: ’lest it come to be’ (μὴ … ἀμφαδὰ ἔργα γένοιτο ’lest the matter become public’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with κε: ’it would be’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., potential with ἄν: ’would become’ (ἡμῖν δ’ ἂν ἐλέγχεα ταῦτα γένοιτο ’and to us these would become reproaches’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a wish after a hortatory subj., no particle: ’let it arise, may it come about’ (βοὴ δ’ ὤκιστα γένοιτο ’and let a cry go up quickly’)
__broaden__.εἴξειε: εἴκω — yield, give ground; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a general relative clause (ὅ τε … εἴξειε ’whoever gave way’) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a clause of aim after εἴ πώς: ’in case he might give way’ (εἴ πώς οἱ εἴξειε θυράων ’in case he might yield the doors’)
__broaden__.ζώοντος: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. part. masc. gen. sg., agreeing with παιδός: ’living’ · also pres. part. masc. gen. sg. in a genitive absolute with αὐτοῦ: ’while he is alive’
__broaden__.κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’ · also neut. acc. sg. governed by ἐς: ’into evil’ (ἐς κακὸν … βάλῃσθα) · also neut. acc. sg. subject of an infinitive: ’an evil’ (κακὸν ἔμμεναι ’that an evil is’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of εἴη: ’evil’ (μή τι κακὸν … εἴη ’and may no evil be’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ῥάκος: ’vile’ (ῥάκος ἄλλο κακὸν ’another, a vile rag’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a finite verb: ’an evil’ (ἐπεὶ κακὸν ἔμπεσεν οἴκῳ ’since an evil fell upon the house’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with γενοίμην: ’a bane, an evil (to them)’ · also masc. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’a base man’ (κακὸς κακὸν ἡγηλάζει) · also masc. acc. sg., attributive with θάνατον: ’evil’ (θάνατον … κακόν ’evil death’)
__broaden__.λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’ · also partitive gen. after a relative: οἵ ... λαῶν ἡμετέρων ’those of our people who’ · also partitive gen. after an adjective of rank: πάντων ἀριδείκετε λαῶν ’most distinguished of all the people’ · also gen. governed by πρόσθεν: ’before (the city and) the people’ · also gen. governed by φείδεο ’spare’: ’spare your people’ (φείδεο λαῶν σῶν)
__broaden__.μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · with acc. also ’in quest of, in search of’ (μετὰ χαλκόν ’after bronze’) · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also adverb, ’among them, in their midst’: μετὰ δὲ πρέπει ἀγρομένοισιν ’and he stands out among the gathered’ · also as preverb in tmesis (μετὰ … βεβήκει = μεταβεβήκει ’had moved on, passed on’) · also a plain adverb, ’afterwards’ (μετὰ γάρ τε καὶ ἄλγεσι τέρπεται ἀνήρ ’for afterwards a man takes pleasure even in pains’; some take it as ’among’ with ἄλγεσι) · also + dat. of the mind, ’in’ (μετὰ φρεσὶ σῇσι ’in your mind’) · also + dat. of the hands, ’in’ (μετὰ χερσὶν ἐνώμα ’was turning in his hands’)
__broaden__.μοίρῃ: μοῖρα — share, portion; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic μοίρᾳ) · also in ἐν μοίρῃ, ’in due measure, rightly’ (ἐν μοίρῃ πέφαται ’has been slain deservedly’)
__broaden__.πρόσθε: πρόσθε — before, in front; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’in front of’ (πρόσθε ποδῶν ’before his feet’)
__broaden__.πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive · also bare adv. ’formerly’, no art./inf. · also + aor. subj., ’before’ (πρὶν … ἐπέλθῃ ’before it comes upon’) · also + opt.: ’before’ (πρὶν τλαίη ’before he would bring himself’) · also adv. with a finite verb, ’before that, sooner’ (πρὶν … ἀγείρετο ’before that … came gathering’) · also + fut. indic.: ’before’ (πρὶν … γαῖα καθέξει ’before the earth covers’) · also with a bare noun, the verb understood: ’before’ (πρὶν ὥρη ’before it is time’) · also adv. ’till then, before that’ in a clause with no finite verb (πρὶν δ’ οὔ τι νεμεσσητὸν κεχολῶσθαι ’till then it is no cause for blame to be angry’)
__broaden__.πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’ · also accented before the enclitic οἱ: ’somehow’ (εἴ πώς οἱ εἴξειε ’in case he might somehow yield’)
__broaden__.πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἰθύν: ’for every (undertaking)’ · also ’the whole’ (of a single extent, not distributive ’every’): πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’, acc. of duration · also agreeing with ὑπερβασίην: ’all, the whole of’ (πᾶσαν … ὑπερβασίην ’all their transgression’)
__broaden__.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας: ’your (prize)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆρ as subject: ’your (heart)’ (σὸν κῆρ ἰανθῇ)
__broaden__.τιμὴν: τιμή — honour, privilege, worth; acc. sg. · also compensation, the price set on a wrong; acc. sg., object of ἄγοντες: ’a payment’ (τιμὴν … ἐεικοσάβοιον ’a payment worth twenty oxen’)
__broaden__.τραπέζῃ: τράπεζα — table; fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (Ionic η for α), locative: ’at table’ · also dat. sg. with περιρρηδής: ’over the table’ (περιρρηδὴς … τραπέζῃ)
__broaden__.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’ · also distributive, neut. nom./acc. sg.: τὸ μὲν … τὸ δὲ ’one thing … another’ · also article-like before the adverb πρόσθεν: ’formerly’ (τὸ πρόσθεν ὄλοντο ’died long before’) · also article-like before a substantivized adjective, neut.: τὸ μέλαν ’the dark (part)’ · also article-like before the adverb πάροιθε: ’formerly’ (τὸ πάροιθε ’in former times’) · also article-like before an infinitive, which it makes a noun: ’the (keeping watch)’ (τὸ φυλάσσειν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. acc. sg., object of its clause (τὸ πρὶν μέν ῥ’ ἐφόρει ’which he used to carry before’) · also demonstrative, neut. acc. sg., object of a verb: ’this, that’ (τὸ δὲ νήπιοι οὐκ ἐνόησαν ’but the fools did not perceive this’)
__broaden__.χαλκήρεϊ: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze (χαλκός + ἀραρίσκω ’fit’); fem. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic -ει) · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί (the adjective has two endings): ’bronze-fitted’
__broaden__.χθόνα: χθών — earth, ground; fem. acc. sg., after ἀνά: ’over the earth’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of τύπτε and ἤλασε: ’the ground’ (χθόνα τύπτε μετώπῳ ’beat the ground with his forehead’)
__broaden__.ἐείσατο: εἴδομαι — seem, appear; aor. 3 sg. ἐείσατο, unaugmented: ’seemed’ · also ἵημι (mid. ἵεμαι) — rush, set oneself against; aor. 3 sg. mid. ἐείσατο, unaugmented: ’rushed at’ (Ἀμφίνομος Ὀδυσῆος ἐείσατο ’Amphinomus made for Odysseus’)
__broaden__.ἐλάσειε: ἐλαύνω — drive; aor. opt. 3 sg., in a generic relative clause: ’would drive’ · also in an alternative deliberation (ἠὲ … ἦ …): ’should drive’ (ἦ πρὸς γῆν ἐλάσειε κάρη) · also aor. opt. 3 sg. in a fear clause after μή, secondary sequence: ’lest he drive (a sword)’ (μή τις … ἐλάσειε … φασγάνῳ ’lest someone drive in with a sword’)
__broaden__.ἔλθωμεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. subj. 1 pl.: ’we may come’ · also hortatory aor. subj. 1 pl. in a main clause: ’let us go’ (ἔλθωμεν δ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’and let us go through the town’)
__broaden__.ὄπισθεν: ὄπισθεν — behind, from behind; adv. · also of time: ’afterwards, hereafter’ (ἄμμες ὄπισθεν ἀρεσσάμενοι ’we afterwards making amends’)
__broaden__.κύνες: κύων — dog; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’dogs!’ (ὦ κύνες)
__broaden__.παντὶ: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to everyone’ (or ’to everything’) · also agreeing with a noun: ’whole, all of’ (παντὶ μετώπῳ ’with the whole forehead’)
